title: FableCut: The AI Video Editor Where the AI Actually Edits
description:
Someone just made a video editor where the AI is literally the editor, not just an assistant 🔥

It's called FableCut, a browser based editor built from ground up to be run by AI agents. The whole trick is that your entire timeline is one single JSON file, so Claude Code or Claude Desktop can edit it directly through a built in MCP server. And it ships with zero npm dependencies which is kinda wild.

The part that got me: the agent actualy watches your video, understands the scenes, and drops in cuts and effects by itself. Then you see the result right in your browser instantly 😅 no manual timeline dragging.

This is not a assistant sitting next to an editor, its the editor. You can find it by searching GitHub for ronak create FableCut ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
